summary: Reviewed 4 units. Total issues: 1 error, 9 minor (9 with machine patch). Error: unit 2 Hindi adds 'महान्' to the refrain (only unit 1 has mahām urum). Minor: rodasī rendered Heaven and Earth instead of the two worlds (glossary), kratu as powers instead of resolve (glossary), vīrya as कर्म, 'grown great' addition, split of viśvam ādevam in the Hindi, majmanā gender (verify). Units 1 ok; the uncertain readings (nṛto = O dancer, Krivi, ādevam) are honestly marked low confidence. No regrouping suggested (unit 4 three printed lines for four pādas is fine).
